# PrometAI

> > AI-powered business planning platform that guides entrepreneurs from idea validation through valuation and founding team assembly.

PrometAI is an intelligent business plan generator and startup toolkit designed to help founders create investor-ready business plans, validate ideas, and make data-driven decisions. The platform combines AI capabilities with structured frameworks like PESTEL and Porter's Five Forces to streamline the entrepreneurial journey.

## Core Platform & Tools

- [AI Business Plan Generator](https://prometai.app): PrometAI homepage: AI-powered business plan generator for founders.
- [Entrepreneur Journey Map](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey): PrometAI's Entrepreneur Journey Map guides founders through business startup steps.
- [Business Idea Generation](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey/idea): AI-powered business idea generation and validation tool by PrometAI.
- [Business Name and Brand Tools](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey/name-brand): PrometAI tools for business naming and brand identity generation.
- [Build Founding Team](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey/founders): PrometAI tools for building founding teams and defining roles.
- [Business Risk Management](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey/risks): Business risk management and assessment tools from PrometAI.
- [Valuation & Financial Analysis](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey/valuation): PrometAI's DCF valuation and profit analysis tools for startups.
- [Advanced Analysis Tools](https://prometai.app/entrepreneur-journey/other-resources): PrometAI analysis tools for scenario modeling and financial planning.
